tools.name: LinkedIn
tools.description: Large professional network with job listings, recruiter messaging and company pages. Highest volume of corporate roles, but also high application competition and some stale postings.
tools.notes: Cross-check listings against the company career page before applying.

tools.name: Indeed
tools.description: Aggregates listings from employers and other boards. Strong for volume and entry-level roles; listings can be duplicated or outdated, so filter by recent posting date.
tools.notes: Now also the login and listings source for Glassdoor.

tools.name: Google for Jobs
tools.description: Search 'jobs' on Google to see listings pulled from employer career pages and partner boards in one place. Useful as a cross-check against stale or duplicate postings.
features: Pulls from employer career pages and partner boards
Filters by date, type and location
tools.notes: No dedicated homepage; the feature appears inside Google Search.

tools.name: LinkUp
tools.tagline: Job search limited to company career pages
tools.description: Job search engine that indexes openings directly from employer career sites rather than third-party boards, which reduces duplicates and outdated listings.
tools.notes: Strongest coverage is believed to be the US; check India coverage.

tools.name: HiringCafe
tools.tagline: Job search built from employer applicant-tracking systems
tools.description: Search engine that indexes openings from company applicant-tracking systems, with granular filters and AI-assisted search. Listings can still be stale; verify before applying.
features: Detailed salary, remote and stack filters
tools.notes: Only a blog review found; no independent audit of listing quality.

tools.name: Wellfound
tools.tagline: Startup jobs with direct founder contact
tools.description: Startup-focused job marketplace, formerly AngelList Talent. Free for job seekers, with salary and equity shown on many listings. Company response rates are a common complaint.
features: Salary and equity on many listings
tools.notes: Some reviewers report low response rates and disappearing messages.

tools.name: Work at a Startup (Y Combinator)
tools.description: Official job board for Y Combinator companies. One profile lets you apply to many startups, from early-stage to larger scaleups.
features: Filters by role and company stage
tools.notes: Not independently researched in this pass; verify features on the site.

tools.name: Welcome to the Jungle
tools.tagline: Culture-focused job search for tech and creative roles
tools.description: Employer-branding and job platform that absorbed Otta in 2024. Company profiles, salary ranges and matching for tech, product and creative roles, mainly in Europe, the UK and the US.
features: Salary and work-policy details on listings
tools.notes: Merged from two earlier entries (Otta and Welcome to the Jungle).

tools.name: Lenny's Jobs
tools.tagline: Job board for product, growth and engineering roles
tools.description: Curated job board from the Lenny's Newsletter community, aimed at product managers, engineers and growth leaders at tech companies.
tools.notes: Not independently researched; verify before featuring.

tools.name: a16z Portfolio Jobs
tools.tagline: Jobs across Andreessen Horowitz portfolio companies
tools.description: Official job board for companies backed by Andreessen Horowitz, covering areas such as AI, crypto, bio, fintech and enterprise software.
features: Filters by stage, role and focus area
tools.notes: Listing counts change daily and were removed from the description.

tools.name: Upwork
tools.description: Freelance marketplace where you bid on projects or get hired directly. Freelancer fee is variable per contract and proposals use paid Connects.
tools.pricing: Free to join; variable 0-15% freelancer fee (typically about 10%) plus paid Connects
tools.notes: Sources disagree (variable 0-15% vs flat 10%); confirm on Upwork's fee page.

tools.name: Toptal
tools.description: Screened freelance network for developers, designers, finance and product experts. Free for talent; clients pay a premium. The acceptance rate is Toptal's own claim.
tools.pricing: Free for talent; clients pay a premium
tools.notes: Reported client deposit of about $500.

tools.name: Fiverr
tools.description: Create fixed-scope gigs and let clients order them. Sellers keep 80% of earnings; buyers pay an extra service fee. Competition and price pressure are high.
tools.pricing: Free to join; 20% seller commission plus about 5.5% buyer fee

tools.name: Contra
tools.description: Freelance platform with no commission on freelancer earnings and portfolio-style profiles. Contra Pro is paid and reportedly gets more visibility. Fewer projects than larger platforms.
tools.notes: Best suited to designers and creatives.

tools.name: Lemon.io
tools.description: Developer network matching vetted engineers, mainly from Europe and Latin America, with startups. Developers keep their quoted rate; clients pay a markup.
tools.notes: Its stated acceptance rate is a company claim.

tools.name: Arc.dev
tools.tagline: Remote developer jobs, freelance and full-time
tools.description: Platform for remote developers covering freelance, contract and full-time roles. Combines AI-assisted matching with human review.
tools.notes: Moved from Job Boards; it covers both freelance and permanent work.

tools.name: Braintrust
tools.tagline: Talent marketplace with no fee for talent
tools.description: Talent marketplace where freelancers keep their full rate and clients pay the platform fee. It now also sells AI recruiting and interviewing products.
tools.pricing: Free for talent; client pays the fee
tools.notes: Old 'Web3/Decentralized' tags removed as outdated.

tools.name: Gun.io
tools.description: Network of vetted freelance developers, mostly serving US-based clients on contract and contract-to-hire work.
tools.notes: Added from third-party comparisons; verify details on the site.

tools.name: Turing
tools.description: Platform that matches remote software engineers with US and global companies for contract and full-time roles after a skills assessment.
tools.notes: Added from third-party comparisons; verify details on the site.

tools.name: Uplers
tools.description: Network that vets engineers, marketers and designers and places them with US, UK and global employers on remote contracts.
tools.notes: Not independently researched; vetting stage count removed because it is unverified.

tools.name: Behance
tools.description: Adobe-owned portfolio platform for designers, photographers and other creatives, with a creative job board.

tools.name: Dribbble
tools.description: Community where designers share work and companies post design jobs and freelance briefs.

tools.name: Glassdoor
tools.tagline: Company reviews, salaries and interview questions
tools.description: Anonymous employee reviews, salary data and interview questions. It merged into Indeed in July 2026; sign-in uses an Indeed account and job listings sync from Indeed.
tools.notes: Re-categorised from Job Boards; use as a research tool.

tools.name: GhostJobs.io
tools.tagline: Community database of suspected ghost jobs
tools.description: Community-driven database that flags job listings suspected to be fake or inactive. Useful as a quick check before applying.
tools.notes: Accuracy depends on community reports; treat as a signal, not proof.

tools.name: We Work Remotely
tools.description: Remote-only job board covering development, design, marketing, support and more. Listings are reviewed, but there is no guarantee of employer response.
tools.notes: Ghost jobs and recruiter spam still occur.

tools.name: Remote OK
tools.description: High-volume remote job board with salary information on many tech listings and timezone and nomad filters.

tools.name: Remotive
tools.description: Curated remote job board for developers, customer success, design and marketing, with an active community.
tools.notes: Not independently researched; verify before featuring.

tools.name: FlexJobs
tools.description: Paid subscription board that says every listing is manually screened for remote and flexible work. Subscription cost is the main trade-off.
tools.notes: Screening is the company's stated policy.

tools.name: Virtual Vocations
tools.description: Telecommute-focused job database with staff-researched listings and a remote company directory. Free and paid membership tiers.

tools.name: Working Nomads
tools.tagline: Curated remote jobs for location-independent workers
tools.description: Curated remote job lists for engineering, design, copywriting and more, aimed at people who work from anywhere.
tools.notes: Not independently researched.

tools.name: Himalayas
tools.tagline: Remote jobs with salary and company details
tools.description: Remote job board that shows salary ranges, timezone overlap filters and company profiles with tech stack information.
tools.notes: Not independently researched; the claim of salary on every listing was softened.

tools.name: Dynamite Jobs
tools.description: Curated remote openings from remote-first employers, with filters for timezone and visa requirements.
tools.notes: Not independently researched.

tools.name: Jobspresso
tools.tagline: Curated remote jobs in tech and marketing
tools.description: Remote job board with manually reviewed listings in tech, marketing and support, from startups and established companies.
tools.notes: Not independently researched.

tools.name: Remote.io
tools.tagline: Remote jobs for tech, design and product
tools.description: Remote job board with filters for timezone and regional eligibility, covering tech, design, product and support roles.
tools.notes: Not independently researched.

tools.name: Naukri.com
tools.description: Dominant Indian job portal for IT services, BFSI and enterprise roles. Large resume database; paid boosts are optional for job seekers.
tools.notes: Recruiter count removed because it is unverified.

tools.name: Instahyre
tools.tagline: Curated tech hiring platform in India
tools.description: Matches tech candidates with startups and product companies in India; companies reach out to matched profiles.

tools.name: Cutshort
tools.tagline: Tech hiring platform for startups in India
tools.description: Matching platform connecting tech talent with startups and product companies; recruiters can message candidates directly.

tools.name: Hirist
tools.description: India-focused portal for technology and product roles, often recommended for experienced engineers.
tools.notes: Added; URL not live-checked.

tools.name: Foundit
tools.tagline: Job portal for India, APAC and the Middle East
tools.description: Formerly Monster India. A secondary option alongside Naukri for mid and senior roles, particularly IT and BFSI.
tools.notes: Smaller database than Naukri; heavy overlap.

tools.name: iimjobs
tools.tagline: Management and finance jobs in India
tools.description: India-focused portal for management, finance and consulting roles.
tools.notes: Added; URL and tiers not live-checked.

tools.name: Internshala
tools.tagline: Internships and fresher jobs in India
tools.description: Platform for internships, trainings and entry-level jobs aimed at students and freshers in India.
tools.notes: Added; URL not live-checked.

tools.name: Apna
tools.tagline: Entry-level and local jobs in India
tools.description: Job app for entry-level, local and frontline roles in India, with in-app chat with employers.
tools.notes: Added; URL not live-checked.

tools.name: National Career Service (NCS)
tools.description: Free job listings run by the Government of India, including public and private sector openings and career resources.
tools.notes: Added; URL not live-checked.

tools.name: Unstop
tools.description: Platform for students and freshers with hiring challenges, hackathons, internships and entry-level tech jobs.
tools.notes: Not independently researched.

tools.name: TimesJobs
tools.description: Job portal for corporate, IT and managerial roles in India. Current standing is unclear; use as a low-priority secondary source.
tools.notes: Current status could not be confirmed during research.

tools.name: ZipRecruiter
tools.description: Job marketplace with matching and one-click apply, strongest in the US and Canada. Check whether the India site is useful for your needs.
tools.notes: Original entry linked to the .in site; India usefulness unverified.

tools.name: Dice
tools.description: Technology-focused job board for software developers and IT professionals, with contract and full-time roles, mainly in the US.

tools.name: Handshake
tools.tagline: Jobs and internships for students and recent graduates
tools.description: Early-career job platform connecting students and recent graduates with employers, especially in the US.
tools.notes: Added; mainly US-focused.

tools.name: NextHire Talent Assist
tools.tagline: Paid outreach service from an Indian recruitment firm
tools.description: Paid service from NextHire Consulting that uses an AI agent to email hiring managers on your behalf. Not a job board.
tools.pricing: Paid; fixed upfront pricing stated by the company
features: Emails sent from your own address
tools.notes: The app link app.nexthireconsulting.com/home could not be viewed (JavaScript app). No 'yellow pages by country' feature was found. Several unrelated companies share the name. Read the terms before granting email access.
